decisive_items: Doughy skin with palpable bilateral piezogenic papules
Increased range of motion in elbows, hips, and knees with normal strength
response.rationale: R2 best fits Ehlers-Danlos syndrome with joint hypermobility, skin findings, and high-arched palate; R1 lacks aortic involvement and has normal echo, R3 is contradicted by unremarkable MRA without aneurysms.

rejected.why: Normal aortic measurements and tricuspid valve contradict Marfan; no skin or joint hypermobility features.
MRA shows no aneurysms despite family history; lacks typical Loeys-Dietz craniofacial and vascular findings.
